title: Deeala asked to help Pilk Dane

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Hey. I've been hearin' things about you. Good things. Mostly. You're making waves here in the LUZ. Good for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey. I've been hearin' things about you. Good things. Mostly. You're making waves here in the LUZ. Good for you.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I got some updates for you. A LOT has happened since we last spoke. You wanna hear about it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I got some updates for you. A LOT has happened since we last spoke. You wanna hear about it?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Yes. You know I work nights? And you know what I do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. You know I work nights? And you know what I do?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: No! What the fuck?! No! Look, I'm not angry you think I'm a sex worker. No shame in that! I'm angry you didn't listen. That's... really disappointing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No! What the fuck?! No! Look, I'm not angry you think I'm a sex worker. No shame in that! I'm angry you didn't listen. That's... really disappointing.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: He wants me to help him learn how to write better roasts of people.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He wants me to help him learn how to write better roasts of people.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: He wants to do a roast at The Laugh Lounge. Roasts are where comedians get up on stage and say the meanest thing they can about another comedian.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He wants to do a roast at The Laugh Lounge. Roasts are where comedians get up on stage and say the meanest thing they can about another comedian.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Rarely, but sometimes it gets so awkward that people laugh to avoid crawling out of their own skin.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Rarely, but sometimes it gets so awkward that people laugh to avoid crawling out of their own skin.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Fuck... Am I? I don't know. I don't even like being in the same room as him. Can I really teach him how to be MORE of an arsehole?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck... Am I? I don't know. I don't even like being in the same room as him. Can I really teach him how to be MORE of an arsehole?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Have you heard his jokes? He's NEVER going to make it as a comedian. And his skin is thinner than a radioactive tomato from the Ventz.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you heard his jokes? He's NEVER going to make it as a comedian. And his skin is thinner than a radioactive tomato from the Ventz.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Maybe? Or maybe...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe? Or maybe...

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Bingo bango. And I'm good at it. Really fucking good. The problem is, this fucking landlord knows how good I am.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bingo bango. And I'm good at it. Really fucking good. The problem is, this fucking landlord knows how good I am.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Maybe you could help? Maybe you could teach him? For me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe you could help? Maybe you could teach him? For me.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: No, not exactly. That would be impossible. I mean teach him what a roast is like.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, not exactly. That would be impossible. I mean teach him what a roast is like.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: When you destroy him, he'll be too embarrassed to admit the truth. And then he can't be mad at me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When you destroy him, he'll be too embarrassed to admit the truth. And then he can't be mad at me.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I mean ideally, yeah. But if not, maybe at least he gives up roasts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean ideally, yeah. But if not, maybe at least he gives up roasts.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: You'll find me here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll find me here.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: His defining trait is fragility. He can't take criticism. At all. How is a guy like that going to survive a comedy roast?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: His defining trait is fragility. He can't take criticism. At all. How is a guy like that going to survive a comedy roast?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Say you're helping him. but then roast him so bad, he never tries comedy ever again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Say you're helping him. but then roast him so bad, he never tries comedy ever again.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Maybe he'll stop messing with my apartment. He needs to leave me alone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe he'll stop messing with my apartment. He needs to leave me alone.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: It might work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It might work.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Fuck off then!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck off then!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I was hoping to see you again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was hoping to see you again.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I was hoping to see you again.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I was hoping to see you again.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hi Deeala.

nodes.speaker: Player

pronounText.TextSheVersion: More problems with your landlord Pilk Dane?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: More problems with your landlord Pilk Dane?

nodes.text: Are you going to help him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you going to help him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you going to help him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you going to help him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think you have much choice.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't think you have much choice.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't think you have much choice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe you need to let him fail?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe you need to let him fail?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe you need to let him fail?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe you can roast him and he will realize he's out of his depth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe you can roast him and he will realize he's out of his depth.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe you can roast him and he will realize he's out of his depth.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe you can roast him and he will realize he's out of his depth.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There must be another way.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Teach him how to be a comedian?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Teach him how to be a comedian?!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Teach him how to be a comedian?!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Teach him how to be a comedian?!

pronounText.TextSheVersion: And then he gives up comedy?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And then he gives up comedy?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hmm, I'll think about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmm, I'll think about it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What does he want?

nodes.speaker: Player
